project_type: AWS AI League competition agent - Lambda-based tools with system prompts
build_system: pytest for tests, no formal build step
test_framework: pytest / unittest - tests/test_agent.py covers all Lambda handlers
verification_instructions: Run python -m pytest tests/ -v and confirm all tests pass. The prompts are text files that don't have automated tests - they are evaluated in the live competition.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure Python with no external dependencies
environment_constraints: Has internet access. The prompt files are plain text, no compilation needed.
contribution_requirements: Do not hardcode answers for kiosk mode. Keep prompts token-efficient. Door transformation rules are game mechanics, not hardcoded answers.
key_patterns: System prompts are plain .txt files. Each tool has a Lambda handler (.py) and a system prompt. The supervisor orchestrates challenge routing. Token efficiency matters for scoring.
directory_structure: Flat structure: .py Lambda handlers + .txt system prompts + tests/ directory
